articles.summary: Boating in saltwater opens up destinations that freshwater can't always match. Watching dolphins play nearby while you're surrounded by crystal water & open blue skies is a different kind of magic.What you may not know is that using a wake boat in saltwater is totally doable with the right preparation.
articles.title: How to Use Your Malibu in Salt Water

articles.summary: If you're like us, you spend all winter counting down the days until you can get back out on your Malibu and enjoy time spent with family and friends. While you wait for summer or your next boating trip, here's a good reminder of the safe boating practices that keep everyone on the water and having fun.
articles.title: Boating Safety Essentials: What Every Boat Owner Needs to Know

articles.summary: When you go shopping for a wake boat, it's perfectly normal to get distracted by the flashy paint jobs, onboard gadgets, and interior customization options offered on modern wake boats. But the reality is that the most important component of any wake boat is the engine.
articles.title: Malibu MONSOON Engines: Everything You Ever Wanted to Know
